description: LibreWPF transport package with portable managed presentation assemblies, references, themes, XAML build tasks, and runtime metadata.
releaseNotes: Consumes ProGPU preview.54 and adds portable logical primary-screen, work-area, and virtual-screen metrics for SystemParameters; retains per-monitor DPI propagation, multi-window popup routing, the portable WPF window-icon contract, WebGPU adapter-selection diagnostics, exact transformed and shader-backed stroke replay, bounded render-resource ownership, static-frame render suppression, nonactivating window state, settled popup placement, alpha-capable X11 transparent windows, and native Cocoa popups.
